title: Kagamine Rin — The Reason We Met〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Where am I...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It feels like I've always been here but I was asleep the entire time or something...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's nothing here and it's so quiet...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it's a little brighter over there...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, you found me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes. It felt like someone was calling me here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Called here? Mafuyu? The feelings of those that created this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Probably. But that doesn't seem quite right for some reason either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure whether or not that's true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe it wasn't just Mafuyu. Maybe you were called here by everyone else's feelings too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade and the others were able to find Mafuyu here, and Mafuyu welcomed them into this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place may slowly change from being a place where nobody was.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the ones that created this SEKAI already found their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mafuyu. Along with Kanade, Mizuki and Ena...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I was able to meet you here, Rin, because this SEKAI is slowly starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: True.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? Did someone else just arrive?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Ena is here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena... Is it okay if I go see her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That might not be a good idea right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on how she was before, she may want to be left alone for a while longer.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku. That just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know. Kanade and the others are here. They're probably looking for Ena.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin. Could you go to Kanade and the others first and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think I know...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I think I know whose feelings it was that called me here. I know what I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, take me to Kanade and the others. I have this feeling that's telling me that I must meet them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. Then let's go.
